_comment: Example pipeline for pipeline_runner.py. Copy to pipeline.json (gitignored) and delete the steps for platforms you do not use: a standalone script without credentials fails rather than skipping, unlike run_sync.py. Script paths are relative to the repo root. See docs/health.md.

daily.description: Nightly refresh: independent API pulls, then a backup, then the health check and change-only alert.

waves.description: Independent pulls. None reads another's output, so they overlap; SQLite still serialises their writes behind db.BUSY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.

steps.description: The ad-platform connectors; skips any without credentials. Amazon Ads can sit in its report queue for hours, hence the budget.
The order connectors, in their own step: run_sync.py runs its connectors one after another, so sharing a step with Amazon Ads would hold the orders back until its reports finish.
Current-state snapshot with no backfill: a missed day is lost for good.
Fulfilled by TikTok stock levels: snapshot-only like amazon_inventory; the movement records re-pull a trailing week.

waves.description: After the pulls: catalog_sync rebuilds product_xref, which also reads the order tables run_sync.py just refreshed.
Back up only after every writer above has finished.
Free-space probe: always exits 0, logs a `disk_space` row that warehouse_health reads. Must precede the health check.
Strictly last: both read everything. --report-only keeps a found ERROR from marking the whole run failed; health_alerts is what reaches a person.

weekly.description: Slower, heavier pulls that do not need a daily cadence.
